lines.zh: 我一步一步朝你走过来。
lines.en: I come toward you, step by step.
However fast you walk, I keep pace.
I do not go around; I come straight through.

lines.zh: 地板在我脚下响了一声。
lines.en: The floor creaks under me.

lines.zh: 我停在离你四格的地方。
lines.en: I stop four blocks from you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，光暗下去。
lines.en: The light dims where I have passed.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一高一低地走着。
lines.en: I walk with one shoulder higher.
I go around behind you.
I reach the door and turn back.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，墙就挪一点。
lines.en: With each step, the walls seem to shift.
I am not hurrying; you cannot get far.
I stand there, my face toward you.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像在等你眨眼。
lines.en: I stay still, waiting for you to blink.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，角度不太对。
lines.en: I tilt my head at a slightly wrong angle.
The room is strangely quiet.
My breathing cannot be heard.

lines.zh: 墙上有一条裂，我盯着它。
lines.en: There is a crack in the wall; I stare at it.

lines.zh: 我站着的时候，影子在动。
lines.en: When I stand still, my shadow moves.

lines.zh: 我没有影子该有的位置。
lines.en: My shadow is in the wrong place.

lines.zh: 这个地方比刚才小了一点。
lines.en: This room is a little smaller than before.
I wait for you to move that foot first.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地挤着空气。
lines.en: I stand motionless, pressing on the air.
The lamp flickers and I remain unchanged.
I hear you counting.
You turn your head, and here I am.
What were you looking for just now?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛不眨，我也不眨。
lines.en: You do not blink; neither do I.
I am one block closer than last time.
You touched the back of your neck, didn't you.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚才朝我这边偏了。
lines.en: Your shadow leaned toward me.

lines.zh: 你看不见我的时候，我也在。
lines.en: When you cannot see me, I am still here.
Have you counted the corners of this room?
This room holds only you and me.
When you speak, the air does not move.

lines.zh: 你一退，我就把空隙填上。
lines.en: When you retreat, I fill the gap.

lines.zh: 我的脸和刚才不一样了。
lines.en: My face is not the same as before.
You stood behind the door a long while.
You want the light and cannot find the switch.
Your breathing is shallower than before.
There is a wall behind you as well.
I do not intend to move aside.
At last you are not looking at me.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，位置却变了。
lines.en: You hit me, and your position changed.
I do not bleed; I only skew.
That pushed me into the wall.

lines.zh: 我发出一点很低的声音。
lines.en: I make a very low sound.
What you struck did not feel solid.
You overcommitted and caught nothing.
This body is not entirely here.
The more you strike, the closer I get.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我看上了。
lines.en: I have taken a liking to what you hold.
I reach out slowly.

lines.zh: 你把它放在地上，就没事。
lines.en: Set it down and nothing happens.
That little light will give you away.
I move toward the bright side.
I know you are hiding something.
I stare at your pocket.
I am one block from it.
Put it down, then back to the wall.
You strike my chest.
That touch put you somewhere else.

lines.zh: 屋子转了一下，你不在地上了。
lines.en: The room turned, and you are no longer there.

lines.zh: 我碰你，你就移到十六格内某处。
lines.en: A touch and you land somewhere within sixteen blocks.
You land in a different corner.

lines.zh: 我把你推得找不到方向。
lines.en: I push you until you lose your bearings.
Your things remain where they were.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，你就去了别处。
lines.en: One bump and you are elsewhere.
The wall catches you.
When you return, I am already here.
There is nothing else in this place.

lines.zh: 我连自己是不是一个都难说。
lines.en: I cannot even say whether I am one.
Tell that to the wall.
I do not come in twos; I come as a shadow.
I tilt my head, a little late.

lines.zh: 这个问题让我卡了一下。
lines.en: That question made me stall.
I am here, and only here.
I drift toward the door.
Don't ask; just look at me.
I bend and pick it up.

lines.zh: 它在我手里，你看不见了。
lines.en: It is in my hand and you cannot see it.

lines.zh: 我把它放到你找不到的地方。
lines.en: I put it where you cannot find it.
This object has changed position.
I lift it and turn it over.
It was at your feet; I was faster.

lines.zh: 我放下的地方，你昨天走过。
lines.en: I set it where you walked yesterday.
It is not very heavy.
I fold it and put it away.
To find it, you will have to go round.
If you heard it, it is already too late.
I turn toward you.
I have claimed this corner.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子只有一个出口。
lines.en: This room has only one way out.
I walk toward you, never hurrying.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把照不亮我。
lines.en: Your torch does not illuminate me.
You have backed into a corner; good.
From this step, I begin to close in.
When you turn, I am a little faster.
Listen; the footsteps are wrong.
I need not run; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你选了一个没有退路的房间。
lines.en: You chose a room with no way out.
Your voice catches in your throat.
The wall behind you is growing cold.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，就会被甩远。
lines.en: Touch me once and you are flung far.
I move with your steps.

lines.zh: 你走进走廊，我也进去了。
lines.en: You enter the corridor; so do I.

lines.zh: 你回头，我离得比刚才近。
lines.en: You look back; I am nearer than before.
You turn the corner; I wait for you to finish.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，一直与你并行。
lines.en: I hug the wall, always parallel to you.
Your lamp is trembling.
I count the rise and fall of your chest.
I stand at the other end of the corridor.
When you stop, I stop.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声越来越像我的。
lines.en: Your footsteps sound more and more like mine.
You closed the door; the door is useless.
I pass through the door softly.
You watch me from the stairs.
I will not climb; I wait for you to come down.
You walked this way just now.
I am always one block behind you.
The faster you go, the calmer I am.
Your shadow turns toward me.

lines.zh: 我每步都踩在你踏过的地方。
lines.en: I step exactly where you stepped.
I am nearly beside you now.
I lay a hand on your shoulder.
At that touch, you are somewhere else.
I push you and the room turns.

lines.zh: 你没有伤口，只是离得远了。
lines.en: You have no wound; you are simply farther away.

lines.zh: 你摔在十六格内的某处。
lines.en: You land somewhere within sixteen blocks.

lines.zh: 你回头，我脸贴着你的脸。
lines.en: You turn and my face is close to yours.

lines.zh: 这一下没有疼，只有错位。
lines.en: There is no pain, only displacement.
You land in a different room.

lines.zh: 我在你落地的地方等你。
lines.en: I wait where you land.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你就又退了几格。
lines.en: I raise a hand and you fall back several blocks.

lines.zh: 你的方向感被我弄乱了。
lines.en: I have scrambled your sense of direction.
I come close; you go away.
You can hear your own heart.
I take one more step.
When you come back for the way, I am still here.
I appear in that corner first.
The light in the room dips.

lines.zh: 你听见一声脚步，只有一声。
lines.en: You hear one footstep, only one.

lines.zh: 空气变凉，然后我就在了。
lines.en: The air cools, and then I am there.

lines.zh: 我站的位置原本是空的。
lines.en: The place I stand was empty before.
I come out of the seam of the wall.

lines.zh: 这间屋子本来不该有别人。
lines.en: This room should not have anyone else.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有任何声音。
lines.en: I appear without any sound.
The lamp in your hand dims.

lines.zh: 我一开始只是一个轮廓。
lines.en: At first I am only an outline.
Slowly I take an edge.
You look back and think you imagined it.
I stand for a long while first.

lines.zh: 地板上的灰被推开一点。
lines.en: The dust on the floor is nudged aside.

lines.zh: 我出现在你觉得安全的地方。
lines.en: I appear where you felt safe.
Your dog refuses to enter this room.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的声音比别人慢。
lines.en: The sound of my breathing is slower than anyone's.
You count the doors and one is missing.
One touch and you're thrown.
I am here now and will not leave.
In the firelight I am thin as paper.

lines.zh: 我落下去，落点没有声音。
lines.en: I fall, and my landing makes no sound.

lines.zh: 水穿过我，我没什么感觉。
lines.en: Water passes through me and I feel little.
The blast scatters me and I re-form.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在我身后的墙。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in the wall behind.

lines.zh: 那道光让我退开了一点。
lines.en: That light pushed me back a little.

lines.zh: 我什么都吃不下，也越来越薄。
lines.en: I cannot eat anything, and I thin away.
The lightning shows me plainly.

lines.zh: 我落进空处，脚步声还在。
lines.en: I fall into the emptiness, and the footsteps stay.
